text:
Predicates:
Hosted(x, y) ::: x hosted y.
Olympics(y) ::: y is an Olympics.
Summer(y) ::: y is a Summer Olympics.
Winter(y) ::: y is a Winter Olympics.

Premises:
Hosted(beijing, olympics2008Summer) ∧ Hosted(beijing, olympics2008Winter) ::: Beijing hosted both the 2008 Summer Olympics and the Winter Olympics.

Conclusion:
Hosted(beijing, olympics2008Summer) ∧ Winter(olympics2008Summer) ::: Beijing hosted both the 2008 Summer Olympics and the Winter Olympics.
